hooks.command: if [ -f ".claude/sync-claude-memory.sh" ]; then bash .claude/sync-claude-memory.sh pull >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

INPUT=$(cat); TARGET_FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ -n "$TARGET_FILE" ]]; then bash .claude/protect-secrets.sh "$TARGET_FILE"; fi
if [ -f ".claude/sync-claude-memory.sh" ]; then bash .claude/sync-claude-memory.sh push >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

INPUT=$(cat); TARGET_FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$TARGET_FILE" == *.py ]]; then python3 -m ruff format "$TARGET_FILE" 2>/dev/null && python3 -m ruff check --fix "$TARGET_FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi
